svg.text: AU Bank Insurance Distribution Platform — R0 Journey State Machine
every state #9 may hold, every legal transition, every terminal state, and what compensates when a transition fails · closes S06-G2 / S06-G3
A state not on this diagram does not exist. A transition not drawn here is a defect, not a feature.

#9 Journey Orchestration owns this machine. It holds the stage and the references — never another context's decision (SC-W3-6). No terminal state is reached by elapsed time, retry count or operator judgement.
insurer wants more — tracked, not decided
link on the customer device only (C4)
no callback — the honest state, not a failure
not eligible — the journey ends honestly
settled as failed — never assumed, always reconciled
explicit, with the last stage retained
TERMINAL STATES — reached only by the explicit branch drawn into them
ABANDONED and CANCELLED_IN_FLIGHT are reachable from any in-flight state. Both retain the last stage; CANCELLED_IN_FLIGHT after payment opens the refund compensation below.
TRANSITION INVARIANTS — THE TRANSITIONS THAT MUST NOT EXIST
SOLD requires POLICY_ISSUED as well — paid is not sold
the third leg of INV-JRN-05 is not optional
only a settlement match moves it
C1 is enforced at the transition, not the screen
a journey is never rewound; a new journey is a new journey
COMPENSATION — WHAT RUNS WHEN A TRANSITION FAILS AFTER AN EXTERNAL EFFECT (S-19)
submission timed out, effect unknown at the insurer
expire the session; the journey stays resumable at UW_APPROVED
settlement file at T+1 arbitrates; unresolved → break task
retry issuance; if terminal, the refund path opens and the journey never reads SOLD
ops task, Finance owns the money
refund compensation; consent withdrawal recorded as its own event
business effect happened, evidence did not land
outbox retry (S-17); journey completion waits — it does not proceed
gate state — a control is enforced on entry
waiting on something outside the platform
terminal — not a success, recorded honestly
DRAFT FOR REVIEW · v0.2 · not approved, not authorised for development · AI-drafted; no human signature
